summary_for_children: Al-Bayyinah means The Clear Evidence. It says people were commanded to worship Allah sincerely, pray and give charity.
environment_concept: A calm morning court with a reading stand holding a closed, covered book, for the purified scriptures and correct writings of 98:2-3, and a clear spring beside a prayer terrace for 98:5. No person is shown, and the Fire and the gardens of the next life (98:6-8) are not pictured.
architecture_and_scenery: A wooden reading stand under a small canopy, a clear spring in a stone basin, a prayer terrace.

areas.name: Purified Pages
areas.description: A reading stand with a closed, covered book. Its words are not shown.

areas.name: Spring of Sincerity
areas.description: A clear spring in a stone basin, so clear you can see the bottom.

areas.name: Prayer and Zakah
areas.description: A quiet terrace for prayer with a box for giving beside it.
